findings.mechanism: The async engine is created with pool_size=10 and max_overflow=0. In the experiment `active_connections`: 40 pieces of work run through with_session against a pool of 10, every one raising, only 10 connections can be checked out simultaneously, causing worker saturation.
findings.remediation: Set engine pool_size to at least the maximum concurrent work count, e.g., pool_size=40, or configure max_overflow to allow extra connections.
findings.arithmetic: pool_size=10; concurrent works=40 → max active connections = min(pool_size, concurrent) = 10. Therefore active_connections ≤10, and workers >10 will block, yielding saturation.

prediction.condition: 40 pieces of work run through with_session against a pool of 10
